node.statement: Thus a compatible amplified rectangular pair has A in S_{P_n,Q_n} and B in S_{Q_n,R_n}; by def-compressed-corner its amplified compressed product is the ordinary compressed product in M_n tensor A, namely A dot B=Co_{P_n,R_n}(AB), which belongs to S_{P_n,R_n}.
